name: Viren Samani, personal profile
note: Started again 21 September 2026, evening. Posts 01 to 04 of the first attempt are in git history and were withdrawn: too corporate, then too specific. The lesson from Lara Acosta, Heather Murray and Viren's own best posts is that a profile post is understood by anyone in an office, in one read, on a phone.
rules: Plain English. If a word needs explaining to someone outside tech, it does not go in.
One idea. A real moment, person, place or number in the first two lines.
A photo of a real room or a real person beats any graphic. Graphics only for carousels.
Under 150 words unless it is a story, and a story earns its length with a quoted line.
No former employer, no assistant, no jargon, no question close, no hashtags. Ask only when there is something real to ask for (a room to fill, a role to fill).
